title.zh: 读书笔记：让无序介质参与计算
title.en: Reading notes: computing with disordered media

excerpt.zh: 从铌酸锂纳米晶体、随机散射与二次谐波，看光学系统如何形成非线性特征映射。整理自第一周读书笔记。
excerpt.en: Lithium niobate nanocrystals, random scattering and second-harmonic generation as a physical route to nonlinear features. Adapted from my original reading notes.

body.zh:
整理自 2025 年 9 月 21 日发布的《第一周读书笔记》。这是对他人论文的阅读记录。

## 读到的工作

《Large-scale photonic computing with nonlinear disordered media》研究由铌酸锂纳米晶体构成的无序多晶薄片。随机准相位匹配、多重散射与二次谐波生成共同作用，使这一物理系统能够提供非线性特征。

## 信息如何经过系统

输入数据首先编码为空间光调制器（SLM）的相位分布。调制后的光照射到无序薄片上，产生线性与非线性散斑，再通过强度探测获得用于机器学习的特征。

这里值得关注的是，光在介质中的传播与非线性作用本身就参与了特征变换。原笔记记录了它在分类、回归和图分类任务中的应用。

## 延伸阅读

原论文发表于 Nature Computational Science 4, 429–439 (2024)。

[阅读原论文](https://doi.org/10.1038/s43588-024-00644-1)

[查看原始读书笔记](https://github.com/LumiereWuChu/LumiereWuChu.github.io/blob/master/content/post/%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%80%E5%91%A8%E8%AF%BB%E4%B9%A6%E7%AC%94%E8%AE%B0/index.md)
body.en:
Adapted from “First-week reading notes,” originally posted on 21 September 2025. This is a reading note about another team's paper.

## The paper

“Large-scale photonic computing with nonlinear disordered media” studies a disordered polycrystalline slab of lithium niobate nanocrystals. Random quasi-phase-matching, multiple scattering and second-harmonic generation combine to produce nonlinear optical features.

## The information path

Input data are encoded in the phase pattern of a spatial light modulator (SLM). The modulated light illuminates the slab, producing linear and nonlinear speckle patterns. Intensity measurements then supply features for machine learning.

Light propagation and nonlinearity within the material therefore participate directly in the feature transformation. My original notes recorded applications to classification, regression and graph classification.

## Further reading

The paper appeared in Nature Computational Science 4, 429–439 (2024).

[Read the paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s43588-024-00644-1)

[Original reading notes](https://github.com/LumiereWuChu/LumiereWuChu.github.io/blob/master/content/post/%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%80%E5%91%A8%E8%AF%BB%E4%B9%A6%E7%AC%94%E8%AE%B0/index.md)

title.zh: 【20260119】AI加速科研却限制科学认知边界
title.en: AI accelerates research but narrows the boundaries of scientific exploration

excerpt.zh: 关于 AI、科研个体效率与群体探索广度的一篇阅读记录。
excerpt.en: A reading note on AI, individual scientific productivity, and the breadth of collective exploration.

body.zh:
> 本文由作者的知乎文章截图整理，保留原文观点与原日期。配图沿用原文，点击可查看大图。 原截图开头有少量文字被悬浮栏遮挡，缺失处未作推测补写。

![科学探索中的群体登山效应](uploads/zhihu-ai-science-2.webp)

在 AI 持续赋能科研的背景下，为何各学科的颠覆性研究成果却在逐年减少？《人工智能促进科学家影响力增长却制约科学认知边界扩张》（“Artificial intelligence tools expand scientists’ impact but contract science’s focus”）

李勇教授团队摒弃停留在关键词层面的浅层检索方法提出**高质量专家标注与大规模语言模型训练**结合的技术路径对跨越近 **50 年**的海量科学文献进行深度扫描构建了横跨**“机器学习、深度学习、生成式 AI”三个时代**、涵盖 **4130 万篇论文**、覆盖 **2857 万研究者**的 AI 赋能科研全景知识图谱形成了 **AI 赋能科学研究的首个基准数据集**为定量刻画 AI 对科学的长期与系统性影响奠定了坚实数据基石

为定量评估 AI 对科学研究的影响团队提出**基于隐蔽变量的科学学分析方法**

将高维科学语义嵌入与复杂学术网络分析结合创新定义 **“知识广度”** 量化指标

——在 **768 维隐嵌向量空间中通过计算向量分布的“直径”与熵值精确度量科学探索认知边界的扩张与收缩**

揭示了出人意料的矛盾效应：

在微观个体层面

AI 助力科学家个体文章发表量**提升至 3.02 倍**

文章引用量**激增至 4.84 倍**

甚至**提早 1.37 年**成为研究项目负责人

![知识广度、引用分布与数据丰度](uploads/zhihu-ai-science-3.webp)

深入机理研究团队进一步发现 **“科学智能引力”** 效应：

AI 的高效率引导研究者集体涌向少量适合 AI 研究的 **“热门山峰”**

这种“群体登山”模式虽加速了已知问题的解决

却无形中固化了科学探索的路径系统性地削弱了科学家向 **“未知山峰”** 探索的广度

（这种大数据分析能发 nature，很精巧，还是得多读文章增加科研工作者 taste）


## 相关论文

Qianyue Hao, Fengli Xu, Yong Li & James Evans. Artificial intelligence tools expand scientists’ impact but contract science’s focus. Nature (2026).

[原论文 / DOI](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-09922-y)
body.en:
> English translation of the author’s Chinese Zhihu article, preserving its original date and viewpoints. Figures retain the original labels; click a figure to enlarge it. A short passage at the beginning is obscured in the source screenshot and has not been guessed or reconstructed.

![The group mountain-climbing effect of scientific exploration](uploads/zhihu-ai-science-2.webp)

As AI continues to empower research, why do disruptive findings across scientific disciplines seem to be declining year by year? Reading “Artificial intelligence tools expand scientists’ impact but contract science’s focus.”

Professor Yong Li’s team moved beyond shallow keyword-based searches. Their approach combines high-quality expert annotation with large language model training to scan scientific literature spanning almost 50 years. Covering the three eras of **machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI**, the resulting knowledge map encompasses **41.3 million papers** and **28.57 million researchers**. It provides a benchmark dataset for AI-enabled scientific research and a foundation for quantifying AI’s long-term, systematic influence on science.

To quantify that influence, the team proposed a latent-variable approach to the science of science. They combined high-dimensional scientific semantic embeddings with complex scholarly network analysis and defined a measure of **“knowledge extent.”** In a **768-dimensional latent embedding space**, the diameter and entropy of the vector distribution measure expansion and contraction in the boundaries of scientific exploration.

The analysis reveals a surprising contradiction.

At the individual level, AI helps scientists raise their publication output to **3.02 times** the previous level and their citation count to **4.84 times**, and become research project leaders **1.37 years earlier**.

![Knowledge extent, citation distribution, and data abundance](uploads/zhihu-ai-science-3.webp)

Looking into the mechanism, the team identified a **“scientific AI gravity”** effect.

AI’s efficiency draws researchers collectively toward a small number of **“popular peaks”** suited to AI research. This **“group mountain-climbing”** pattern accelerates the solution of known problems, but also fixes research paths in place and systematically reduces the breadth of exploration toward **“unknown peaks.”**

(A large-scale data analysis like this can make it into Nature—very clever. I still need to read more papers to develop my taste as a researcher.)

## Paper discussed

Qianyue Hao, Fengli Xu, Yong Li & James Evans. Artificial intelligence tools expand scientists’ impact but contract science’s focus. Nature (2026).

[Read the paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-09922-y)

title.zh: 【20240708】使用可重构元器件进行数学运算和方程求解
title.en: Mathematical operations and equation solving with reconfigurable metadevices

excerpt.zh: 从米勒架构与直接复矩阵架构，看可重构光学系统如何求解方程。
excerpt.en: Reading the Miller and direct complex matrix architectures for reconfigurable equation solving.

body.zh:
> 本文由作者的知乎文章截图整理，保留原文观点与原日期。配图沿用原文，点击可查看大图。

本文是 UPenn 的 Nader Engheta 组发表在 LSA 的一篇论文，从体系结构的层次分析如何使用超构器件进行微积分矩阵方程的求取，并且重点考虑了需要奇异值分解的米勒架构，以及这里介绍的另一种直观直接复矩阵（DCM）架构，它不需要先验数学分解。

大多数基于 MZI 的系统都利用了以下的网络设计：（a）Reck（在光学/量子领域尚属首创）（b）米勒（具有*自配置*特性）和（c）Clements（平衡路径长度）。这三种架构都需要对主运算符进行先验数学分解。

![可重构方程求解器（原截图顶部被悬浮栏遮挡）](uploads/zhihu-metadevices-2.webp)



求解数学方程（或等效地计算矩阵 **A** 的反转）需要在循环系统中实现一个算子（即 **K=I−A**）。在这里，我们探讨了两种不同的可重构架构：

**b 米勒架构**由三个阶段组成，每个阶段代表奇异矩阵分解的三个矩阵。**阶段 V 和 U** 可以作为马赫-曾德尔干涉仪（MZI，**d**）的级联来实现。相比之下，**S** 级可以使用 MZI 或乘法器模块（**e**）实现，其中给定的输入信号可以通过移相器和放大/衰减单元进行相应的修改。

**c 在引入的 DCM 架构**中，可以给出更直接、更直观的相同运算符的实现。在这里，入口级由具有固定分流比的定向耦合器 **f**）组成。每个输出都被驱动到一个专用的乘法器（**e**），在该乘法器中分配所需的矩阵值（这里是 3 × 3 矩阵的示例）。最后，使用一组定向耦合器（**f**）在出口阶段重新组合信号。请注意，MZI 模块可以重构为两个 3dB 耦合器和两个乘法器，使乘法器模块成为两种架构的主要组成模块

![用 Miller 架构求解方程](uploads/zhihu-metadevices-3.webp)


engheta 组的文章主线清晰，值得精读！今天写的粗略，改日再修改。

## 参考文献

Tzarouchis, D.C., Mencagli, M.J., Edwards, B. et al. Mathematical operations and equation solving with reconfigurable metadevices. *Light Sci Appl* **11**, 263 (2022).

[原论文 / DOI](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41377-022-00950-1)

标签：光计算架构。
body.en:
> English translation of the author’s Chinese Zhihu article, preserving its original date and viewpoints. Figures retain the original labels; click a figure to enlarge it.

This paper, published in LSA by Nader Engheta’s group at UPenn, examines at the architectural level how metadevices can be used to solve matrix formulations of integral and differential equations. It focuses on the Miller architecture, which requires singular value decomposition, and a more intuitive direct complex matrix (DCM) architecture introduced here, which requires no prior mathematical decomposition.

Most MZI-based systems use one of the following network designs: (a) Reck, a pioneering design in optics and quantum applications; (b) Miller, with self-configuration capabilities; and (c) Clements, with balanced path lengths. All three require a prior mathematical decomposition of the main operator.

![Reconfigurable equation solver (top obscured in the supplied screenshot)](uploads/zhihu-metadevices-2.webp)

Solving mathematical equations—or equivalently computing the inverse of matrix **A**—requires implementing an operator, **K = I − A**, within a looped system. Two reconfigurable architectures are considered here.

**b. The Miller architecture** consists of three stages corresponding to the three matrices in a singular value decomposition. Stages **V and U** can be implemented as cascades of Mach–Zehnder interferometers (**MZI, d**). Stage **S** can instead use MZIs or multiplier modules (**e**), in which an input signal is modified by phase shifters and amplification or attenuation units.

**c. The proposed DCM architecture** offers a more direct, intuitive implementation of the same operator. The input stage comprises directional couplers (**f**) with fixed splitting ratios. Each output drives a dedicated multiplier (**e**), which is assigned the required matrix value—shown here for a 3 × 3 matrix. Finally, a set of directional couplers (**f**) recombines the signals at the output. An MZI module can be reconfigured as two 3 dB couplers and two multipliers, making the multiplier module a principal building block of both architectures.

![Solving equations with the Miller architecture](uploads/zhihu-metadevices-3.webp)

The Engheta group’s paper has a clear narrative and is worth reading closely! Today’s note is rough; I will revise it another day.

## Reference

Tzarouchis, D. C., Mencagli, M. J., Edwards, B. et al. Mathematical operations and equation solving with reconfigurable metadevices. Light: Science & Applications 11, 263 (2022).

[Read the paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41377-022-00950-1)

title.zh: 读书笔记：《复杂——诞生于秩序与混沌边缘的科学》
title.en: Reading Complexity: science at the edge of order and chaos

excerpt.zh: 从圣塔菲研究所的诞生，思考复杂性、跨学科研究与科学共同体。
excerpt.en: The origins of the Santa Fe Institute, complexity, interdisciplinary research, and scientific community.

body.zh:
> 本文由作者的知乎文章截图整理，保留原文观点与原日期。配图沿用原文，点击可查看大图。

## 思维导图

![《复杂》思维导图（左上角部分被目录按钮遮挡）](uploads/zhihu-complexity-2.webp)

## 内容简介

爱尔兰经济学家布莱恩·阿瑟对于自己躬耕已久的古典经济学长久的质疑终于找到了出口——沉迷于精致、完美、静态的数学模型，又怎么连接得了混乱、复杂、动态的现实？亚当·斯密的无形的手和理性经济人，又怎么解释的了往往由冲动和随机行为支配的股市？与古典经济学的负反馈均衡机制针锋相对的，阿瑟从正反馈机制和报酬递增率出发，建立起了非均衡的新经济学理念，并且从 QWERTY 键盘布局和钟表的走向等等历史渊源中找到了支持自己的论据。然而，不被世人认可的他陷入了长期的失意穷困，这样的苦熬坚持了四年，直到离经叛道者的乐土——圣塔菲研究所（SFI，Santa Fe Institute）的出现。

这个缔造者来自于赫赫有名的罗沙拉莫斯研究所，美国氢弹的出生地，他的名字叫做乔治·考温。在曼哈顿计划结束，美苏关系错综复杂的上世纪八十年代，从繁重的公务中出逃的他深深地对科研氛围和理念感到担忧：优秀的人才各自为战，大学氛围是一潭死水，年轻人为了谋求教职浪费年华，年长者为了争取基金东奔西走，代表最高荣誉的诺贝尔奖偏好只是简化论精致美丽的研究——科研工作者缺少的是，整体性、系统性的观点看待真实的世界的理念以及多学科交叉、团队交流合作的氛围。在得到学术巨擘，诺奖大牛，夸克理论的创始人，马瑞·盖尔曼的支持之后，圣塔菲研究所——这一致力于复杂性科学和系统科学研究的清流开始风风火火地筹办起来。

收到邀请的除了失意的经济学家阿瑟，还有研究医学出身的斯图尔特·考夫曼，博弈游戏高手约翰·荷兰德，正在磨博士后研究的嬉皮士克里斯·朗顿，等等。不仅大家研究的专业风马牛不相及，甚至许多都是有过大学退学经历（荷兰德），玩极限运动滑翔伞摔得浑身骨折（朗顿）的问题学生，但是在他们来到了圣塔菲研究所之后，思想的光芒都开始迸发出来——“我虽然很疯狂，但是这有一堆和我一样疯狂的人”。

在精彩的讨论会议里，物理学家，生物学家，经济学家齐聚一堂，从一开始的轻蔑傲慢慢慢磨合为欣赏理解、互相激发，SFI 诞生一系列成熟的思想硕果：应用报酬递增率的玻璃房经济模型，利用计算机仿真进行的基因网络研究，从下至上的自组织和涌现为标志的人工生命，幂律行为和雪崩动力学作为界定的混沌边缘，由共同进化形成的自适应现象和造物主的奥秘……这些都意味着复杂——这门诞生于混沌与秩序边缘，代表着临界和相变的科学逐渐成型，随之成长的是以倡导跨学科交流进行整体性研究为核心的圣塔菲理念。

## 读后感想

这是一本复杂性科学创立发展的科学史，不仅刻画了圣塔菲研究所兴起壮大的编年史，更是阐述了跨学科交叉集成研讨理念的诞生。

复杂性思维的力量映射入生活，深化对世界的认识。生命是什么？曾几何时，薛定谔的小册子告诉我，生命是负熵，是平衡结构的对立面。但是现在这个观念得到了质的突破，诚如克里斯·朗顿从分子自动机所得出的思辨和归纳：动力系统的秩序与混沌之间的临界是“复杂”，物质状态的固体与流体之间的临界是“相变”，计算指令的执行与停止之间的临界是“无法决定”，而关于存在实体，过于稳定与过于喧闹之间的临界是“生命”，换而言之“智能”——生命不是简单的非平衡，而是远离平衡状态的稳定的耗散结构，是相变，是复杂！革新的世界观使我们得以对身边的世界产生新的思考：明星的一夜爆红和突然糊烂是不是自组织临界性雪崩动力学的体现？粉丝的冲动，在资本的加持下形成狂热的“饭圈”，是不是普利高津自组织结构的涌现？网络上微小的影响能够迅猛地大范围蔓延，不正是由还原论转变到系统论，走向了正反馈的报酬递增率？如是种种。

小说般的叙事结构使得本书具有了《天才在左，疯子在右》的阅读体验。从郁郁寡欢观察猴子的实验员小白到毅然决然走向理论物理研究的追随内心，从酗酒吸毒的嬉皮士到意外失事浑身骨折之后的自强不息，朗顿的人生可称之为励志的传奇，朗顿的思想也是本书笔墨最浓的一抹亮色。“不要怕走错路，每天都能像十八岁一样，开始崭新的旅程”。阿瑟三十年如一日的思考只为在接近真实的思想上前进一小步，创造巨大成就的学者，亦有此烦恼，但是顽强的性格，会使他挺过来，哪怕是四年的苦战，哪怕世人眼中他只是个离经叛道的 loser，实验验证理论的那一天，幸福感会告诉自己一切都值得。荷兰德和考夫曼，科学家的友谊，思想河流的独立奔流与交汇，又是那样的令人动容。

借古讽今，他石攻玉，从圣塔菲研究所的建立，未尝不可以一瞥我国科学体制的问题。考温对于八十世纪美国的吐槽，难道现在不正在中国的大陆上演吗——“从科研机构来看（与政治正好相对立），大学保守得令人无法相信。年轻的博士们不敢打破传统。他们不得不把他们最好的时光耗费在拼命追求在系里谋到一个终身教职。这意味着，他们最好从事那些会得到终身教授委员会认可的研究。而年岁大一些的研究人员不得不一睁开眼睛就拼命去争取研究经费。这意味着，他们不得不把自己的研究计划归整到让基金会可以认同的范畴。”“每个人都必须争取使自己的论文被权威的学术刊物接受和发表，而这些权威的学术刊物几乎只登载属于被认可的领域的论文。”历史的惊人相似让人触目惊心！钱学森先生所期盼的人才与涌现，综合集成研讨厅不正是圣塔菲理念所践行的吗？在如今中国经济身为第二大经济体的年代，应当多想想当年的美国科研是如何“不拘一格降人才”那些走出死水困境的，多想想当年人家什么样的科研条件做出了什么科研成果。

请用复杂的思维，去缔造复合的人才，去诠释真实的世界。

![曼德勃罗集](uploads/zhihu-complexity-3.webp)
body.en:
> English translation of the author’s Chinese Zhihu article, preserving its original date and viewpoints. Figures retain the original labels; click a figure to enlarge it.

## Mind map

![Mind map of Complexity (a small area at top left is obscured by the contents button)](uploads/zhihu-complexity-2.webp)

The mind map follows Gell-Mann and Cowan’s interdisciplinary collaboration; Arthur’s increasing returns and nonequilibrium economics; Holland’s adaptation, genetic algorithms, and bottom-up emergence; Kauffman’s phase transitions, autocatalysis, and Boolean gene networks; and Langton’s artificial life, self-organized criticality, the edge of chaos, power laws, and coevolution.

## What the book is about

The Irish economist Brian Arthur finally found an outlet for his long-standing doubts about the classical economics to which he had devoted himself. How could elegant, perfect, static mathematical models connect to a messy, complex, dynamic reality? How could Adam Smith’s invisible hand and the rational economic actor explain a stock market so often governed by impulses and random behavior? In opposition to the negative-feedback equilibrium mechanisms of classical economics, Arthur started from positive feedback and increasing returns to develop a new, nonequilibrium view of economics. He found supporting evidence in histories such as the QWERTY keyboard layout and the direction in which clock hands move. Yet, unrecognized by others, he endured years of frustration and financial hardship. That struggle continued for four years, until a haven for unconventional thinkers appeared: the Santa Fe Institute (SFI).

Its founder came from the renowned Los Alamos laboratory, the birthplace of the American hydrogen bomb. His name was George Cowan. In the 1980s, after the Manhattan Project and amid complicated US–Soviet relations, he stepped away from demanding public duties and grew deeply concerned about the atmosphere and philosophy of research. Talented people worked in isolation; universities felt stagnant. Young researchers spent their best years seeking faculty positions, while older ones chased funding. Even the Nobel Prize, the highest honor, seemed to favor beautifully refined reductionist research. What was missing was a holistic, systemic way of looking at the real world, along with interdisciplinary exchange and teamwork. With support from the eminent Nobel laureate and originator of quark theory, Murray Gell-Mann, preparations for the Santa Fe Institute—a fresh current devoted to complexity and systems science—gathered momentum.

Alongside the frustrated economist Arthur, invitees included Stuart Kauffman, who had trained in medicine; John Holland, a master of games and strategic thinking; and the hippie Chris Langton, still working through his doctoral research. Their specialties had little in common. Some had dropped out of university, like Holland; others, like Langton, had broken bones throughout their bodies in a hang-gliding accident. Yet after arriving at Santa Fe, their ideas began to shine: “I may be crazy, but here is a whole group of people just as crazy as I am.”

At lively meetings, physicists, biologists, and economists came together. Initial disdain and arrogance gradually became appreciation, understanding, and mutual inspiration. SFI produced a series of mature ideas: the glasshouse economic model based on increasing returns; computer simulations of gene networks; artificial life characterized by bottom-up self-organization and emergence; the edge of chaos delineated through power-law behavior and avalanche dynamics; and adaptation arising through coevolution, offering a glimpse of nature’s creative mysteries. Together these developments gave form to complexity, a science born at the boundary between chaos and order, concerned with criticality and phase transitions. Growing alongside it was the Santa Fe philosophy: interdisciplinary exchange in pursuit of holistic inquiry.

## Reflections after reading

This is a history of the emergence and development of complexity science. It chronicles the rise of the Santa Fe Institute, but also explains how the idea of interdisciplinary, integrative discussion came into being.

Complexity thinking carries into life and deepens our understanding of the world. What is life? Schrödinger’s little book once taught me that life is negative entropy, the opposite of an equilibrium structure. Now that idea has undergone a qualitative change. As Chris Langton reasoned from his molecular automata: the boundary between order and chaos in dynamical systems is “complexity”; between solids and fluids, “phase transition”; between executing and halting a computation, “undecidability”; and between excessive stability and excessive activity in an existing entity, “life,” or, by extension, “intelligence.” Life is not simply nonequilibrium: it is a stable dissipative structure far from equilibrium, a phase transition, complexity itself!

This changed worldview opens new questions about everyday life. Could a celebrity’s overnight rise and sudden collapse reflect self-organized criticality and avalanche dynamics? Could fans’ impulses, amplified by capital into a feverish fandom, be an emergence of Prigogine-like self-organized structures? When tiny online influences spread rapidly across a vast audience, are we not moving from reductionism to systems thinking and toward positive feedback and increasing returns? There are many such questions.

The novel-like narrative gives the book something of the reading experience of “Genius on the Left, Madman on the Right.” Langton’s journey—from an unhappy novice observing monkeys to someone who decisively followed his heart into theoretical physics; from a hippie struggling with drink and drugs to a person rebuilding his life after an accident shattered his body—is an inspiring legend. His ideas are among the book’s most vivid passages. “Do not fear taking the wrong path. Every day, like an eighteen-year-old, you can begin a new journey.”

Arthur thought persistently for thirty years, seeking only to move one small step closer to reality. Scholars who achieve great things also have such troubles. A tenacious character can carry them through four years of struggle, even when everyone else sees them as an unconventional loser. On the day experiments validate the theory, happiness tells them it was all worthwhile. The friendship between Holland and Kauffman—the independent flow and eventual confluence of scientific ideas—is equally moving.

Looking at the past can illuminate the present. The founding of the Santa Fe Institute also offers a glimpse of problems in China’s scientific system. Are Cowan’s complaints about America in the 1980s not being replayed in mainland China today? “Viewed as research institutions, and in contrast to their politics, universities are astonishingly conservative. Young PhDs dare not break with tradition. They have to spend their best years desperately pursuing tenure in a department. That means doing research a tenure committee will approve. Older researchers have to start chasing research funds as soon as they open their eyes. That means fitting research plans into categories foundations will recognize.” “Everyone has to get papers accepted and published in authoritative journals, yet those journals almost exclusively publish work in recognized fields.”

History’s resemblance is startling. Are the talent, emergence, and integrative discussion envisioned by Qian Xuesen not what the Santa Fe philosophy puts into practice? Now that China is the world’s second-largest economy, we should think more about how American science once welcomed unconventional talent and found its way out of stagnation, and about the research conditions under which those achievements were made.

Use complexity in thinking, nurture people who cross disciplines, and interpret the real world.

![The Mandelbrot set](uploads/zhihu-complexity-3.webp)

body.zh:
> 本文由作者的知乎文章截图整理，保留原文观点与原日期。配图沿用原文，点击可查看大图。 原截图开头有少量文字被悬浮栏遮挡，缺失处未作推测补写。

牛津大学团队发表在 Nature Reviews electrical engineering 上的综述中，概述了集成突触

> 原截图此处有文字被知乎悬浮工具栏遮挡，未补写。

，（2）相干电光处理器和（3）全光神经网络，包括光子脉冲神经网络（SNN）

**第一个很有趣的观点是集成光子学走向 3D**——空间光系统提供了大的灵活度和空间自由度，而集成光系统则具有小型化和更广大的潜在应用场景。一个令人兴奋的前景是将传统的自由空间有源元件（如垂直腔表面发射激光阵列、空间光调制器和体积存储以及衍射元件）与集成电路集成在一起。

![神经形态硬件与三维光子系统](uploads/zhihu-neuromorphic-2.webp)

**第二点是关于神经形态计算中的相干适合级联而非相干适合并行的观点。**在前者中，求和操作在电子域中实现，而在后者中，光信号通过干涉直接叠加在光域中。只有在光学上进行乘法累加操作后，信息才会在光电探测器上转换为电信号。相干方法在每次添加后还会保留光学信息（振幅、相位和模式）。这一特性，加上对单个光源的要求，使相干光加速器在级联性方面具有明显的优势。相比之下，对于非相干方法，对具有相同权重矩阵的输入矢量（通过多路复用在波长上分离）进行并行操作是直接的，但对于相干方法来说却很麻烦，因为难以同时准确地控制不同波长的光学相位。

![基于电光转换深度的神经形态计算方案](uploads/zhihu-neuromorphic-3.webp)

**第三点是关于脉冲神经网络的高能效与非线性。**生物神经元的尖峰意味着信号在幅度上的数字化和时间域中的模拟处理。SNN 在具有一致持续时间和幅度的突然短脉冲上工作。这种方法非常适合光子实现，因为短尖峰或脉冲不受电容延迟的抑制，而电容延迟在电子实现中很常见。主要的实现方案包括 SOA、PCM 和 VCSEL。

![脉冲神经网络](uploads/zhihu-neuromorphic-4.webp)

总的来说，实现更高的可扩展性和级联性的三个关键方面包括**最小化光损耗、优化控制和反馈系统及算法以及有效利用光学自由度。**That is to say，光计算的发展需要架构设计和材料器件的双向奔赴，但是目前看来主要的问题是出在材料上。

## 参考文献

Farmakidis, N., Dong, B. & Bhaskaran, H. Integrated photonic neuromorphic computing: opportunities and challenges. Nat Rev Electr Eng 1, 358–373 (2024).

[原论文 / DOI](https://doi.org/10.1038/s44287-024-00050-9)
body.en:
> English translation of the author’s Chinese Zhihu article, preserving its original date and viewpoints. Figures retain the original labels; click a figure to enlarge it. A short passage at the beginning is obscured in the source screenshot and has not been guessed or reconstructed.

In a review published in Nature Reviews Electrical Engineering, a team at Oxford discusses integrated synaptic…

> A passage here is hidden by Zhihu’s floating toolbar in the supplied screenshot. It has not been reconstructed.

…(2) coherent electro-optical processors and (3) all-optical neural networks, including photonic spiking neural networks (SNNs).

**The first particularly interesting idea is the move of integrated photonics toward 3D.** Free-space optical systems offer great flexibility and spatial degrees of freedom, while integrated optical systems offer miniaturization and a wider range of potential applications. One exciting prospect is to combine conventional active free-space components—such as vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser arrays, spatial light modulators, volume storage, and diffractive elements—with integrated circuits.

![Neuromorphic hardware and three-dimensional photonic systems](uploads/zhihu-neuromorphic-2.webp)

**The second point concerns coherent approaches being suitable for cascading and incoherent approaches for parallelism in neuromorphic computing.** In the former, summation is performed in the electronic domain; in the latter, optical signals are added directly through interference in the optical domain. Information is converted into an electrical signal by a photodetector only after optical multiply–accumulate operations. Coherent approaches also retain optical information—amplitude, phase, and mode—after each addition. Together with the requirement for a single light source, this gives coherent optical accelerators a clear advantage in cascading. By contrast, incoherent approaches can straightforwardly operate in parallel on input vectors sharing the same weight matrix, separated in wavelength by multiplexing. This is cumbersome for coherent approaches because it is difficult to control optical phase accurately across different wavelengths simultaneously.

![Neuromorphic computing schemes across electronic and photonic domains](uploads/zhihu-neuromorphic-3.webp)

**The third point concerns the energy efficiency and nonlinearity of spiking neural networks.** Spikes in biological neurons imply digitization in amplitude and analog processing in time. SNNs operate on sudden short pulses with consistent duration and amplitude. This is well suited to photonic implementation, since short spikes or pulses are not constrained by the capacitive delays common in electronic implementations. Main implementation approaches include SOAs, PCMs, and VCSELs.

![Spiking neural networks](uploads/zhihu-neuromorphic-4.webp)

Overall, three key areas for greater scalability and cascadability are **minimizing optical loss, optimizing control and feedback systems and algorithms, and using optical degrees of freedom effectively.** In other words, optical computing needs architectural design and materials/devices to move toward each other. For now, however, the main problems appear to lie in the materials.

## Reference

Farmakidis, N., Dong, B. & Bhaskaran, H. Integrated photonic neuromorphic computing: opportunities and challenges. Nature Reviews Electrical Engineering 1, 358–373 (2024).

[Read the paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s44287-024-00050-9)

excerpt.en: MZI matrix representations, Haar initialization, and optimization of redundant and permuting rectangular meshes.

body.zh:
> 本文由作者的知乎文章截图整理，保留原文观点与原日期。配图沿用原文，点击可查看大图。

今天读一篇斯坦福大学关于使用 MZI 光子器件进行任意矩阵乘法的论文[1]，主要讨论了用 MZI 作为基本单元如何进行局部的相互作用从而 scaling 得到网络，如何进行基于梯度的优化将网络索引空间收敛至随机酉矩阵，以及如何同构优化拓扑连接进行网络架构的改进。

## 一、MZI 构成光子神经网络的显示表达

单模 MZI 移相器本质上是由无损的 50：50 MMI 分光器和相位调制器组成，可以在其输入端执行任意 U(2) 或者 SU（2）变换：

![MZI 实现的酉矩阵](uploads/zhihu-unitary-1.webp)

如果有 N 种输入模式，并且干涉仪连接到波导 n 和 n + 1，那么我们可以将方程 1 中的 2 × 2 U 矩阵嵌入 N 维空间中，具有局部相互作用的酉“给定旋转” Uₙ 定义为：

![MZI 单元嵌入 N 维空间](uploads/zhihu-unitary-2.webp)

嵌入之后的矩阵形式是用之前推导的酉矩阵单元元素替换了单位矩阵中的 2×2 空位，网络中不同的节点代表着矩阵中的不同位置，一共有 N(N−1)/2 个节点，将这些矩阵乘起来就会得到级联网络的矩阵形式

![级联矩阵与对角相移矩阵](uploads/zhihu-unitary-3.webp)

级联的效果如下图所示

![表示局部相互作用的 MZI 矩阵网格图](uploads/zhihu-unitary-4.webp)

## 二、全局收敛性与初始化方法

**全局优化的收敛性：**主要取决于每个相移的灵敏度。本文研究的梯度下降优化在相移正确到某个可接受的范围内时收敛。这个可接受的范围可以根据网格中相移的平均值和方差来严格定义，这些相移共同定义了一个无偏（“Haar 随机”）酉矩阵。为了实现 Haar 随机酉，网格中的一些 MZI 需要偏向 cross 状态（tₙ′=cos²(θ/2)=|U₁₂|²=|U₂₁|² 接近 1，θₙ′ 接近 0）。这种跨态偏置相应地“压缩”了极限交叉态配置附近的透射率和相移可接受范围，从而产生了更高的灵敏度。

对于实现的 Haar 随机酉矩阵，低容差透射式 MZI 位于矩形网格的中心和三角形网格的顶点。对于三角形和矩形网格，每个 MZI 的交叉状态偏置和相应的灵敏度仅取决于可到达波导端口的总数。

**Haar 初始化方法：**在物理环境中，使用均匀变化的 Haar 相位直接设置每个 MZI 可测量透射率 tₙ′，从而完成随机矩阵的光子器件初始化。传统方法中实现的酉矩阵的对角线外非局部元素往往接近于零，因为相距很远的输入和输出之间的转换路径较少（例如，图 1 中的输入 1 和输出 8 具有单个路径）。因此，生成的网格实现了具有带状结构的酉矩阵，该结构随着矩阵尺寸的增加而变得越来越明显。使用 Haar 初始化可以避免带状矩阵的问题，显著提高了梯度下降优化算法的收敛速度。从物理上讲，这与网格中心相比，对应于网格中的光从网格的输入端快速扩散，并在网格边界（输入、输出、顶部和底部）附近“相互作用”，而网格的中心具有高透射率。相反，当相位随机设置时，光线有效地跟随随机游走穿过网格，从而产生如下图（f）所示的场传播模式

![Haar 初始化与均匀随机初始化的场传播比较](uploads/zhihu-unitary-5.webp)

## 三、架构创新

**冗余矩形网格（RRM）：**通过添加额外的可调谐 MZI，可以大大加快矩形网格对未知酉矩阵的优化。在下图（a）中，将冗余可调谐层添加到冗余矩形网格中以绿色表示。使用这种“欠定网格”（输入数小于网格中可调谐层数）可以克服光子误差并恢复酉构造算法的保真度。在网格中添加层会增加器件的整体光学深度，但是在可接受光学深度的矩形网格中嵌入具有额外分光器层的较小网格不会造成固有的波导损耗相关问题。

**置换矩形网格（PRM）：**加速矩形网格优化的另一种方法是在矩形网格内定期随机播放输出。这种改组放宽了组件容差和每个输入输出转换的路径数的均匀性。我们利用这种直觉来正式定义一个排列矩形网格，这些矩形排列模块可以使用由具有固定交叉状态相移的 MZI 组成的矩形网格实现，如下图（b）所示，也可以使用低损耗波导交叉来实现。

额外的可调谐层（绿色）可以显著减少收敛时间。

![冗余矩形网格与置换矩形网格](uploads/zhihu-unitary-6.webp)

初始化光子网格后，我们继续优化未知 Haar 随机酉 U 的均方误差成本函数，采用 F 范数来训练 MZI 网络和任意酉矩阵的拟合。我们使用张量流中的自动微分来模拟酉网格的全局优化，这可以使用参考文献[2]中的原位反向传播程序在物理上实现。这种光学反向传播程序使用干涉技术对 dLtrain/dθₙ“进行物理测量，该技术可以扩展到我们在本文中讨论的任何架构。

## 四、总结

在通用光子网格上基于梯度优化 Haar 随机酉矩阵的可扩展性受到小反射率和 MZI 移相器灵敏度的限制，这些灵敏度是由局部相互作用组件的约束引起的。每个 MZI 所需的平均反射率和灵敏度与受 MZI 影响的输入和输出总数成反比。如果物理组件不满足公差要求，则优化算法将难以收敛到目标酉算子。在 N = 128 的情况下，如果将相器是随机初始化的，则通常无法通过原位反向传播实现收敛。但是，即使存在显著的仿真分光镜制造误差，Haar 初始化也能充分将收敛优化偏置到所需的随机酉矩阵。

此外，本文建议添加额外的可调谐分光镜或网格非局域，以加速网格优化。标准光子网格上的朴素（均匀随机）初始化很难通过梯度下降学习随机酉矩阵。通过在网格中引入非局部性，我们可以提高优化性能，而无需额外的参数。Haar 初始化的冗余架构可以使 Haar 随机酉矩阵的均方误差减少 5 个数量级，并将此类矩阵的优化时间缩短至少两个数量级，如下图所示。研究结果表明，光子网状组件的架构选择和初始化对于提高可重构通用光子器件及其许多经典和量子应用的可扩展性和稳定性可能很重要。

![矩形、置换矩形与冗余矩形网格的训练误差](uploads/zhihu-unitary-7.webp)

矩形（RM）、置换矩形（PRM）和冗余矩形（RRM）网格在 N = 128 的张量流中的测试误差比较：20000 次迭代，Adam 更新，学习率为 0.0025，批大小为 256。Haar 随机初始化 θₙ′ = 0。δN 是在冗余网格中添加的附加层。

## 文献引用

1. Pai, S., Bartlett, B., Solgaard, O., & Miller, D. A. (2019). Matrix optimization on universal unitary photonic devices. Physical Review Applied, 11(6), 064044.

[论文 1 / DOI](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevApplied.11.064044)

2. Tyler W. Hughes, Momchil Minkov, Yu Shi, and Shanhui Fan, “Training of photonic neural networks through in situ backpropagation and gradient measurement,” Optica 5, 864 (2018).
body.en:
> English translation of the author’s Chinese Zhihu article, preserving its original date and viewpoints. Figures retain the original labels; click a figure to enlarge it.

Today I read a Stanford paper on performing arbitrary matrix multiplication with MZI photonic devices [1]. It mainly discusses how local interactions between MZI building blocks scale into a network, how gradient-based optimization converges toward random unitary matrices, and how changes to topological connectivity improve the network architecture.

## 1. Explicit representation of an MZI photonic neural network

A single-mode MZI phase shifter essentially consists of lossless 50:50 MMI splitters and phase modulators, allowing an arbitrary U(2) or SU(2) transformation on its inputs:

![Unitary matrix implemented by an MZI](uploads/zhihu-unitary-1.webp)

With N input modes and an interferometer connecting waveguides n and n + 1, the 2 × 2 matrix U in equation 1 can be embedded in N-dimensional space. The local unitary “Givens rotation” Uₙ is defined as follows:

![Embedding an MZI unit in an N-dimensional space](uploads/zhihu-unitary-2.webp)

This embedding replaces a 2 × 2 block in the identity matrix with the elements of the previously derived unitary cell. Different network nodes represent different matrix positions. There are N(N − 1)/2 nodes in total. Multiplying these matrices gives the matrix representation of the cascaded network.

![Cascaded matrices and the diagonal phase-shift matrix](uploads/zhihu-unitary-3.webp)

The resulting cascade is illustrated below.

![MZI mesh illustrating local interactions](uploads/zhihu-unitary-4.webp)

## 2. Global convergence and initialization

**Convergence of global optimization** primarily depends on the sensitivity of each phase shift. The gradient-descent optimization studied in the paper converges when phase shifts are correct within an acceptable range. That range can be rigorously defined using the means and variances of mesh phase shifts that together specify an unbiased, “Haar-random” unitary matrix. To realize a Haar-random unitary, some MZIs must be biased toward the cross state: tₙ′ = cos²(θ/2) = |U₁₂|² = |U₂₁|² approaches 1, while θₙ′ approaches 0. This bias compresses the acceptable ranges of transmissivity and phase near the extreme cross-state configuration, producing greater sensitivity.

For a Haar-random unitary matrix, the MZIs with low transmissivity tolerance lie at the center of a rectangular mesh and the apex of a triangular mesh. In both mesh types, each MZI’s cross-state bias and corresponding sensitivity depend only on the total number of accessible waveguide ports.

**Haar initialization:** In a physical setting, Haar-distributed phases are used to set each MZI’s measurable transmissivity tₙ′, thereby initializing the photonic device to a random matrix. In conventional initialization, nonlocal, off-diagonal elements of the realized unitary matrix tend to be close to zero because there are fewer conversion paths between distant inputs and outputs—for example, input 1 and output 8 in figure 1 have only a single path. The mesh therefore produces a banded unitary matrix, with banding increasingly evident at larger sizes.

Haar initialization avoids this banded-matrix problem and substantially improves gradient-descent convergence. Physically, light spreads quickly from the mesh inputs and interacts near its boundaries—the inputs, outputs, top, and bottom—while the center has high transmissivity. With randomly set phases, by contrast, light effectively performs a random walk through the mesh, producing the field propagation pattern shown in panel (f).

![Field propagation with Haar and uniform random initialization](uploads/zhihu-unitary-5.webp)

## 3. Architectural innovations

**Redundant rectangular mesh (RRM):** Adding extra tunable MZIs can greatly accelerate optimization of a rectangular mesh toward an unknown unitary matrix. In panel (a) below, the additional tunable layers are shown in green. Such an underdetermined mesh, with fewer inputs than tunable layers, can overcome photonic errors and recover the fidelity of unitary construction algorithms. Adding layers increases the overall optical depth. However, embedding a smaller mesh with extra splitter layers into a rectangular mesh of acceptable optical depth does not introduce an inherent waveguide-loss problem.

**Permuting rectangular mesh (PRM):** Another way to accelerate rectangular-mesh optimization is to periodically shuffle outputs within the mesh. This rearrangement relaxes component tolerances and changes the uniformity of the number of paths available for each input–output conversion. The paper formalizes this intuition as a permuting rectangular mesh. Its permutation blocks can be implemented using a rectangular mesh of MZIs with fixed cross-state phase shifts, as in panel (b), or through low-loss waveguide crossings.

Extra tunable layers, shown in green, can substantially reduce convergence time.

![Redundant and permuting rectangular meshes](uploads/zhihu-unitary-6.webp)

After initializing the photonic mesh, the authors optimize a mean-squared-error cost against an unknown Haar-random unitary U, using the Frobenius norm to train the MZI network to fit an arbitrary unitary matrix. TensorFlow automatic differentiation simulates global optimization of the unitary mesh. Physically, this can be implemented with the in situ backpropagation procedure in reference [2]. That optical backpropagation procedure uses interference to physically measure dLtrain/dθₙ and can be extended to any architecture discussed in the paper.

## 4. Summary

The scalability of gradient-based optimization of Haar-random unitary matrices on universal photonic meshes is limited by small reflectivities and MZI phase-shifter sensitivities arising from constraints on locally interacting components. The mean reflectivity and sensitivity required by each MZI are inversely related to the total number of inputs and outputs it affects. If physical components do not meet tolerance requirements, optimization struggles to converge to the target unitary operator. For N = 128, random phase-shifter initialization generally fails to converge through in situ backpropagation. Haar initialization, however, can sufficiently bias optimization toward the desired random unitary matrix even with significant simulated splitter fabrication errors.

The paper also proposes extra tunable splitters or mesh nonlocality to accelerate optimization. Naive, uniform-random initialization on a standard photonic mesh struggles to learn random unitary matrices by gradient descent. Adding nonlocality improves optimization without extra parameters. A Haar-initialized redundant architecture can reduce mean squared error for Haar-random unitaries by five orders of magnitude and shorten optimization time by at least two orders, as illustrated below. The results suggest that architecture and initialization are important for improving the scalability and stability of reconfigurable universal photonic devices and their classical and quantum applications.
